description: This Java source file defines the NameSupport class, which provides support for managing name layout templates within the OpenMRS medical record system. It handles initialization, loading, updating, and serialization of name templates based on global properties, and listens for changes to global properties related to name formatting.

classes.name: NameSupport
classes.description: A class providing support for name layout templates, including loading and updating templates based on global property changes, implemented as a singleton extending LayoutSupport and listening to global property events.

methods.name: NameSupport
methods.description: Constructor initializing the singleton instance if not already set.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of NameSupport, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the layout templates based on the 'layout.name.template' global property.

methods.name: updateLayoutTemplates
methods.description: Updates existing layout templates with a provided NameTemplate object.

methods.name: deserializeXmlTemplate
methods.description: Deserializes an XML string into a NameTemplate object.

methods.name: getDefaultLayoutFormat
methods.description: Returns the default layout format, either from global properties or a default value.

methods.name: supportsPropertyName
methods.description: Checks if the given property name is supported by this listener.

methods.name: globalPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to global properties related to name templates, updating layout templates as needed.

methods.name: globalPropertyDeleted
methods.description: Handles deletion of global properties, currently empty.
